title: Debt default
stat: **15** countries hit this in most futures · **15.5** expected across all 30

fields.label: What sets it off
fields.text: Debt passes 100% of GDP, or 85% while reserves are also running out. Lenders stop rolling over its bonds.

fields.label: It has happened before
fields.text: Sri Lanka defaulted on its foreign debt in 2022, the first default in its history. Lebanon defaulted in 2020.

title: Currency collapse
stat: **14** countries hit this in most futures · **13.1** expected across all 30

fields.label: What sets it off
fields.text: Reserves fall below one month of imports, so the country can no longer pay for fuel, fertiliser or medicine from abroad.

fields.label: It has happened before
fields.text: In early 2023 Pakistan's central-bank reserves fell to roughly three weeks of imports before it reached a new IMF deal.

title: Food emergency
stat: **1** country hits this in most futures · **2.5** expected across all 30

fields.label: What sets it off
fields.text: A failed monsoon hits a country that cannot grow enough food and cannot buy it, because neighbours restrict grain sales or reserves are thin.

fields.label: It has happened before
fields.text: After the droughts of 1965 and 1966, India depended on shipments of American wheat, a period remembered as living 'ship to mouth'.

title: Water conflict
stat: **0** countries hit this in most futures · **1.3** expected across all 30

fields.label: What sets it off
fields.text: In a drought, a hostile upstream neighbour holds back river water from a country that relies on it.

fields.label: It has happened before
fields.text: The Cauvery dispute already turns violent in dry years: Bengaluru saw riots in 2016 after the Supreme Court ordered Karnataka to release water to Tamil Nadu.

title: Mass unrest
stat: **0** countries hit this in most futures · **0.1** expected across all 30

fields.label: What sets it off
fields.text: Political stability, which falls with weak growth, food shortages and earlier crises, drops so low that the government falls.

fields.label: It has happened before
fields.text: Sri Lanka's 2022 protests forced its president to flee and resign. Bangladesh's government fell to a protest movement in 2024.

title: Border war
stat: **0** countries hit this in most futures · **1.8** expected across all 30

fields.label: What sets it off
fields.text: Countries on the Pakistan, China or Myanmar borders face a small yearly risk of fighting. About a third of clashes escalate into war.

fields.label: It has happened before
fields.text: India fought Pakistan at Kargil in 1999 and clashed with China in the Galwan Valley in 2020. A small new country would face them alone.
